text:
Alex: Quick Q4 milestone check — M1: p95 <150ms for hosted API, M2: model-routing v2 rollout. Short status: what shipped, what slipped, owners & next actions. cc @Maya @Devon
Maya: M1 update — search perf change merged (PR #4120). Canary metrics: p95 down ~18ms. Still seeing KV cache cold-start spike ~=250ms on a few hosts. Filed issue https://rwd.io/issue/638
Devon: M2 routing: started canary, found variant mismatch under mixed-batch. Implemented a temporary fallback to the older variant; paused full rollout. Owner = Devon, will coordinate with infra on capacity and compat checks.
Sam: Quick CR ping — left 2 small comments on #4120 about batch sizing and a log line. low risk. @Jen can you help prioritize review?
Jen: I can take the review after stand. If Sam's comments are tiny we can ship the change during Tue maintenance window at 09:00 PST (avoid demo week). Also I will open the capacity escalation for Dedicated GPUs.
Alex: Sounds good. For the KV warmup regression, priority = high. Who's triaging the root cause? @Maya?
Maya: I'll lead triage with Eng-Infra. Plan: reproduce with exact warmup timeline, collect kv-stats, add a micro-cache priming patch if needed. ETA: EOD Wed for initial findings.
Devon: Note on M2 dependency: without reserved capacity bump, routing can cause p95 regressions under peak. @Jen please escalate reserved GPU request to infra.
Jen: Opening ticket INF-2247 with priority=high and linking this thread.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy of search-perf v1.3 completed on 3 hosts — 3/3 healthy. Logs: https://ci.rwd.io/build/1234
Sam: Once PR #4120 is green and comments addressed I can LGTM. Also tagging docs: @Devon please add a short release-note blurb about the fallback behavior.
Devon: Will add release notes and an ops playbook note about fallback semantics.
Alex: TL;DR next steps: (1) Maya triage KV warmup (EOD Wed) (2) Jen escalate GPUs (INF-2247) (3) Devon finish routing canary & add release notes (4) Sam quick LGTM on #4120. Ping back here as items close. :thumbsup:
Maya: Will post triage notes and repro logs here when available.
Sam: Addressed comments, merging now.
deploy-bot: PR #4120 merged by Sam.
